name: B699-R12-dispatch-context
description: Compact, byte-addressable context core for two web Pro/Huan handoffs.

layout.shared: shared/r13-original.zip is the exact R13 outer ZIP byte stream.
layout.i18: packages/i18 contains every i18 source member except its one nested R13-Pro ZIP; that member is read from shared/r13-original.zip.
layout.r12: packages/r12 contains every R12 source member except its one nested R13 evidence ZIP; that member is copied byte-for-byte from shared/r13-original.zip.
layout.r13: There is no duplicate packages/r13 tree; prepare_context.py restores all R13 members directly from shared/r13-original.zip.

outer_archive_statement: The compact packet intentionally omits the i18 and R12 outer ZIP files. Their original attachments remain the authoritative source bytes. The packet therefore makes no same-hash reconstruction claim for those omitted outer ZIPs.
integrity_statement: Every included member is mapped in PACKET_SOURCES.json by original member name, size, SHA-256, storage location, and restore path. The two shared nested relationships are checked before packaging and again during restoration.
safety_statement: build_context.py and prepare_context.py perform only path validation, copying, unpacking, size checks, and SHA-256 checks. They reject unsafe paths/symlinks and refuse same-name destination overwrites. They never execute package code, proof checkers, certificates, or Lean.
navigation_statement: CURRENT_STATE.md, TASK_PROTOCOL.md, SOURCE_MAP.md, TASK-A.md, and TASK-B.md are not prewritten. A later build may add supplied copies from a navigation/ directory.
